title: Optimized method for the extraction of contaminant-free IgY antibodies from egg yolk using PEG 6000
author: Madera-Contreras, Solano-Texta, et al.

steps.title: Separate yolk from white
steps.instruction: Wear nitrile or latex gloves, carefully crack the egg, transfer egg white and yolk to a yolk spoon, discard the white. Cut a 15 × 15 cm piece of filter paper, place the yolk on it without breaking, and roll the yolk over the paper to remove remaining egg white.

steps.title: Aspirate yolk into tubes
steps.instruction: Pierce the yolk membrane with a lancet, aspirate the liquid yolk into three 15 mL tubes, recording the volume in each tube as V1 (use a 10 mL syringe if desired).

steps.title: Add PBS and 3.5 % PEG
steps.instruction: To each tube add PBS equal to twice the measured V1 (2 × V1) and mix to a homogeneous solution (volume V2). Calculate 3.5 % w/v PEG 6000 based on V2 and add the corresponding grams to each tube.

steps.title: Vortex and shake
steps.instruction: Vortex the tubes for 2 min, then place them on an orbital shaker at 200 rpm for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 3500 rpm for 15 min.

steps.title: Collect superficial layers
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, remove the top two layers (yellow fatty layer and the clear IgY‑containing layer) and transfer them to a new tube.

steps.title: Filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Pass the collected layers through a folded filter paper twice, collecting the filtrate as V3. If a yellow layer remains after the second filtration, repeat the filtration once more or repeat the 3.5 % PEG addition step.

steps.title: Add 8.5 % PEG and precipitate
steps.instruction: Add PEG 6000 at 8.5 % w/v calculated on V3 volume, then vortex 2 min, shake 10 min at 200 rpm, and centrifuge 3500 rpm for 15 min (same as steps 4‑5).

steps.title: Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 1 mL PBS to the pellet, pipette‑mix until the volume reaches 10 mL (V4). Add PEG 6000 at 12 % w/v based on V4.

steps.title: Second precipitation
steps.instruction: Vortex 2 min, shake 10 min at 200 rpm, centrifuge 3500 rpm for 15 min (repeat steps 4‑5).

steps.title: Final wash and aliquot
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 2.4 mL PBS to the pellet, gently homogenize without creating bubbles. Divide the 2.4 mL into ~50 µL aliquots, store at –20 °C (do not freeze at –70 °C). Use one aliquot to quantify total protein (mg/mL) by the electrophoresis method.
